title: 第64章 困蝠追西奔 冰牢阻追兵第63章 灵果涤身垢 古木再深行
lines: 罗止正手握苍纹陨铁枪走在最前方，枪尖微垂，一路拨开拦路的杂枝与外露树根，稳稳开路。李紫云左手紧握着灵角寒霜弓紧随在后，脚步轻盈踩在腐叶之上，目光不停扫视两侧林木暗处。随峰飞在队伍前路的低空位置，靠前探路警戒，双翼轻敛减少多余响动，锐利眼眸紧盯前路树梢、树洞各处隐患，提前排查前路潜藏的危险。
一行人辞别云心古木中段高地，顺着绵长舒缓的坡面慢慢下行，渐渐踏入古木后段地界。起初下坡走势平缓柔和，地面铺满长年朽烂形成的黑褐落叶，落脚绵软悄无声息，身旁古树愈发粗壮苍劲，青白气根零零散散自枝头垂落，林木之间空隙宽裕，轻薄雾气慢悠悠在林间游荡，空气里满是湿润的草木寒气。

越往腹地深入，缓坡的落差慢慢凸显，大量老树根破土凸起，纵横盘绕横亘在行进路上，树上垂落的气根日渐稠密，交错缠绕形成层层根幔，原本流动的白雾慢慢凝滞沉坠，林间能见度不断收窄，阴冷湿气顺着衣衫缝隙缓缓浸透皮肉。待到行至后段深处，整片大地化作连绵匀缓的下坡，地表完全被错综纠缠的巨根包裹，织成连片厚重根网，一棵棵参天巨木的树干、树杈之上，遍布大大小小深浅不一的天然树洞，浓稠深青色雾霭沉沉压覆林间，遮去所有星月光芒，四下静谧死寂，只剩地底木灵脉缓慢涌动的淡淡气韵。
顺着这片幽深林地稳步前行约一里，天光被厚重浓雾一点点吞噬，暮色漫过树梢，夜幕彻底铺满整片古林。
罗止正脚步骤然停驻，眉眼审慎地扫过四周密匝树洞与翻涌浓雾，嗓音沉稳放缓开口：“天色已然全黑，遍地树洞多半是灵兽巢穴，夜间赶路隐患重重，我们先寻一处稳妥之地休整过夜。”
李紫云闻声立时驻足，左手牢牢握紧灵角寒霜弓，眸色警惕环视幽暗林间，语气温和轻缓应道：“也好，入夜密林视线太差，就地歇息最为稳妥。”
原本在前低空探路的随峰闻声折返，双翼轻振，在二人周遭低空盘旋一周，细致排查周遭数丈范围的动静。确认近处暂无妖兽异动后，它方才收拢羽翼，落至一旁粗壮的古树枝干之上，浅蓝眼眸始终警惕锁定头顶成片幽暗树洞，持续保持警戒姿态。
二人就近寻了一处巨木根系环抱的避风空地，俯身仔细清理干净地面的枯枝腐叶，露出一片平整干爽的落脚之地。
罗止正直起身，侧头看向身旁李紫云，神色淡然出声：“我去拾些干柴，生火取暖，也好驱散林间湿寒与阴邪气息。”
李紫云微微点头，身姿轻转，语气平和应答：“我随你一同去，速去速回。”
言罢，二人分头散开，在周边林间捡拾干透的枯枝断木。夜色浓雾笼罩之下，二人动作利落，不多时便各自抱得一堆干燥柴木，折返回到空地之中。
罗止正屈膝蹲身，双手灵巧摆弄，将粗细不一的枯枝层层堆叠，搭起一座中空透气的简易柴架。他指尖微微颤动，丹田火属性灵力流转凝聚，一簇细碎温热的火灵力骤然窜出，精准落进柴架缝隙之中。
干燥枯枝遇火即燃，细碎火星窜动，橙红色的火苗顺势腾起，迅速引燃整座柴架。暖亮的火光层层铺开，驱散周遭浓稠的幽暗与湿冷，将二人与随峰的影子长长映在交错的树根之上。
林间沉沉的雾气被火光烘得微微浮动，方才压抑死寂的氛围，稍稍缓解几分。
罗止正蹲在火堆边，随手拣起三根粗细匀称的枯树枝，抽出腰间骨刀，刀锋翻飞削尖枝梢。收刀后探入储物袋取出三块灵蟒肉逐一穿好，架在篝火上方慢慢炙烤。
火苗缓缓舔舐肉块表层，油脂受热不停滋滋滚落，坠进火堆溅起细碎火星，浓郁的肉食香气顺着流动的暖风漫开，冲淡林间四处萦绕的阴冷腥气。
李紫云移步挨着火堆席地而坐，鼻尖萦绕烤肉香气，眉眼舒展，轻声开口：“奔波整整一日，刚好借这灵蟒肉食补足损耗的体力。”
罗止正半跪在地，时不时抬手转动木枝调整受热方位，神色从容应声：“灵蟒肉蕴有微薄灵气，吃完打坐调息，恢复效率也能高出不少。”
停驻在粗大树干上的随峰不曾放松戒备，浅蓝眼眸在火光与浓重黑雾间来回游走，视线牢牢锁死头顶密布的树洞，即便闻到诱人肉香，也依旧恪守值守本分。
林间只剩柴火轻响与四散漫溢的灵肉鲜香，整片古林陷入短暂的安逸松弛。
也就在肉块尚且炙烤、二人身心稍稍放松的这片刻，头顶成片隐在浓雾里的树洞之中，原本漆黑空洞的暗处，一点一点，接连亮起一双双幽绿冷眸。
无数冰冷瞳仁藏在暗影浓雾之内，密密麻麻悬于半空，无声俯瞰下方的篝火与两道人影，蛰伏已久的凶戾气息，正悄然浸透整片密林。
转瞬之间，成群黑影陆续自幽深树洞窜出，全数展露躯体样貌。蝠身体型比肩成年雄鹰，体表布满粗糙暗沉的灰褐色短茸毛，薄韧宽大的肉翼延展铺开，翼皮之上萦绕细碎淡黑风系纹路，嘴部凸出两枚泛着冷光的弯钩尖牙，一双幽绿竖瞳在火光反衬下泛着残忍寒光。它们双翼构造得天独厚，振翅几乎不会产生破空噪音，搭配周遭浓稠雾气便能藏匿周身形体，擅长群居潜藏树洞，专挑暗夜借迷雾潜行围猎。
这正是雾影幽林蝠，凡级三阶中期灵兽。
漫天蝠群放弃隐匿，成群裹着刺骨腥风俯冲而下，密密麻麻直奔篝火边二人袭来。
枝干上的随峰浅蓝眼眸骤然凝起，羽翼紧绷，立时进入迎战状态。
罗止正嗅到扑面而来的腥臭味，神色骤变，手掌飞快探向身侧竖放的苍纹陨铁枪。
一旁席地而坐的李紫云瞬间敛去闲适神态，左手迅速抄起身侧平放的灵角寒霜弓，身子顺势后撤半步，全神戒备半空袭来的蝠群。
蝠群阵型错落分开，居于最前的巨型头蝠率先催动招式，双翼猛然大幅度抡摆，周遭风元素被急速牵引，数道凝实锋利的青色风刃破空飞射，朝着二人劈斩而来，锋锐之气似要割裂皮肉筋骨。
这正是碎风斩翼。
蹲踞粗枝的随峰骤然舒展双翼，裹挟风水二气腾空而起，直面升空的头蝠悬于半空对峙。
它眸光凝厉，周身狂暴的风灵力尽数涌入双翼，振翅催动灵力外放。数道风刃扇形爆射而出，彼此交织成密布的风网，大范围迎向头蝠劈来的漫天风刃。
这正是随峰的苍风裂空刃。
轰隆一声脆响，双方风刃于半空猛烈碰撞，四散的劲风掀得周遭浓雾翻涌碎裂，头蝠仓促收拢翼身后撤数尺，被对冲余波震得躯体微微发颤。
前线大批蝠群趁浓雾遮掩身形，周身裹绕流转风劲，身形骤然化作一道道灰褐残影极速冲刺，利爪獠牙寒光毕露，从四面八方迅猛扑咬向火堆旁的二人。
这正是迅风突掠。
眼见数只蝙蝠飞速猛扑而来，李紫云左手高擎灵角寒霜弓，弓身凌空一震，刺骨寒气自弓纹间狂涌而出。
戴着寒冰软皮手套的右手猛地后拉空弦，引动四周寒气疯狂汇聚而来。
弓心之上，寒气骤然凝聚炸裂，三支通体冰晶铸炼、寒光慑人的冰魄箭，在弓弦上凭空凝实成形，箭尖寒芒暴涨数尺，冻得空气层层扭曲。
她弓开如满月，腕间灵力轰然迸发。
“冰魄箭！”
字音未落，三道冰蓝色箭矢齐射而出，如三道寒芒破空，去势疾如流星，所过之处空气凝结成细密冰屑，拖出三道晶莹冷冽的光痕。
箭矢转瞬即至，一支直射一只蝙蝠头颅，一支射向另一只胸口，另一支狠狠钉在第三只翅膀之上，刹那间寒气炸开，冰层顺着三处伤口疯狂蔓延，三只蝙蝠大半身躯冻得僵硬难动，彻底失去闪躲与反抗之力，重重摔落地面。
content_en:
Luo Zhi was walking at the front with a blue-grained iron spear in his hand, the tip of the spear slightly hanging, pushing aside the twigs and exposed tree roots that were blocking the road, and steadily opening the way. Li Ziyun followed closely, holding the Spirit Horn Frost Bow tightly in his left hand, stepping lightly on the rotten leaves, and kept scanning the darkness of the trees on both sides. Sui Feng flew at a low-altitude position in front of the team, staying forward to explore the road and be vigilant. His wings were lightly folded to reduce unnecessary noise, and his sharp eyes were focused on hidden dangers in the treetops and tree holes on the road ahead, to check for potential dangers on the road ahead in advance.
The group bid farewell to the high ground in the middle of Yunxin Gumu, slowly descended along the long and gentle slope, and gradually entered the back section of Gumu. At first, the downhill slope was gentle and gentle. The ground was covered with dark brown leaves formed by years of decay. The footfalls were soft and silent. The ancient trees beside me became stronger and more vigorous. Green and white roots were scattered and hanging from the branches. There were plenty of gaps between the trees. Light mist slowly wandered in the forest. The air was filled with the moist chill of the vegetation.
As we go deeper into the hinterland, the gradient of the gentle slope gradually becomes more prominent. A large number of old tree roots protrude through the soil and coil vertically and horizontally on the road. The hanging aerial roots on the trees become increasingly dense and intertwined to form layers of root mantles. The originally flowing white mist slowly freezes and sinks, the visibility in the forest continues to narrow, and the cold moisture slowly penetrates the skin and flesh along the gaps in the clothes. When we reached the deep end of the journey, the entire land turned into a continuous and gentle downhill slope. The surface of the land was completely wrapped by intricately entangled giant roots, woven into a thick network of roots. On the trunks and branches of towering giant trees, There are natural tree holes of different sizes and depths all over, and the thick dark blue mist weighs heavily on the forest, blocking out all the light of the stars and the moon. It is quiet and dead everywhere, leaving only the faint aura of the slow surging spirit veins of the underground wood.
After walking steadily along this deep forest for about a mile, the skylight was gradually swallowed up by the thick fog, twilight spread over the treetops, and the night completely covered the entire ancient forest.
Luo Zhi's steps suddenly stopped, his eyebrows and eyes carefully scanned the dense tree holes and billowing fog around him, and he spoke in a calm and slow voice: "It is already completely dark, and the tree holes everywhere are probably the nests of spiritual beasts. There are many hidden dangers when traveling at night, so let's find a safe place to rest for the night."
Li Ziyun stopped immediately when he heard the sound, holding the Spirit Horn Frost Bow firmly in his left hand, looking around the dark forest with alert eyes, and responded with a gentle tone: "It's okay, the visibility in the dense forest at night is too poor, it is best to rest on the spot."
Sui Feng, who was originally exploring the path at low altitude, turned back after hearing the sound. He fluttered his wings lightly and hovered at low altitude around the two of them, carefully investigating the movements within a few feet of the surrounding area. After confirming that there were no monsters nearby, it folded its wings and landed on a thick ancient branch nearby. Its light blue eyes were always alert to the dark tree hole above its head, and continued to maintain a vigilant posture.
The two found a nearby sheltered space surrounded by the roots of a giant tree. They leaned over and carefully cleaned away the dead branches and leaves on the ground, revealing a flat, dry place to stay.
Luo Zhi stood up straight, looked sideways at Li Ziyun beside him, and said calmly: "I'm going to pick up some dry firewood and light a fire to keep warm, so as to dispel the dampness, coldness and evil smell in the forest."
Li Ziyun nodded slightly, turned slightly, and responded in a calm tone: "I will go with you. Go and come back as soon as possible."
After saying that, the two of them dispersed and picked up dry dead branches and broken trees in the surrounding forest. Shrouded in thick night fog, the two of them moved swiftly, and soon they each carried a pile of dry firewood and returned to the open space.
Luo Zhizheng was squatting with his knees bent and dexterously playing with his hands, stacking dead branches of different thicknesses on top of each other to build a simple firewood rack that was hollow and breathable. His fingertips trembled slightly, and the fire-attribute spiritual power in his Dantian flowed and condensed. A cluster of fine, warm fire spiritual power suddenly sprang out and fell accurately into the gap of the firewood rack.
"Crack-"
Dry dead branches ignited when exposed to fire. The fine sparks danced, and orange-red flames rose up, quickly igniting the entire firewood stand. The warm and bright firelight spread out layer by layer, dispersing the thick darkness and dampness around them, casting the shadows of the two of them and Sui Feng on the intertwined tree roots.
The heavy mist in the forest was slightly floated by the firelight, and the oppressive and dead atmosphere was slightly relieved.
Luo Zhi was squatting by the fire, picking up three dead branches of even thickness, pulling out the bone knife from his waist, and whirling the blade to sharpen the branches. After putting away the knife, he reached into the storage bag and took out three pieces of spirit python meat, threaded them one by one, and placed them over the campfire to roast slowly.
The flames slowly licked the surface of the meat, and the fat kept rolling off the heat. When it fell into the fire, it splashed fine sparks. The rich meat aroma spread along the flowing warm wind, diluting the cold and fishy smell lingering in the forest.
Li Ziyun moved to sit on the ground next to the fire, the aroma of barbecue lingering on the tip of his nose, his eyebrows relaxed, and he spoke softly: "I have been running around all day, and I just need this spiritual python meat to replenish my lost energy."
Luo Zhi was half-kneeling on the ground, raising his hands from time to time to turn the wooden branches to adjust the heating position. He responded calmly: "The meat of the spiritual python contains a small amount of spiritual energy. After eating, meditating and adjusting the breath, the recovery efficiency will be much higher."
Sui Feng, who was parked on the thick tree trunk, never relaxed his guard. His light blue eyes wandered back and forth between the firelight and the thick black mist. His gaze was firmly locked on the dense tree holes above his head. Even if he smelled the tempting aroma of meat, he still adhered to his duty.
Only the sound of firewood and the fragrance of souls and flesh were left in the forest, and the entire ancient forest fell into a brief moment of comfort and relaxation.
At this moment when the meat was still roasting and the two of them were slightly relaxed, a tree hole above their heads was hidden in the thick fog. In the originally dark and empty darkness, little by little, pairs of cold green eyes lit up one after another.
Countless cold pupils were hidden in the thick shadows and fog, hanging densely in the air, silently overlooking the bonfire and two figures below. The ferocious aura that had been dormant for a long time was quietly permeating the entire dense forest.
In the blink of an eye, groups of black shadows emerged from the deep tree holes one after another, all showing their bodies. The body of the bat is as big as that of an adult eagle. Its body is covered with short, rough, dark gray-brown hairs. Its thin, tough and wide fleshy wings are spread out. There are fine black wind lines on the wing skin. Two hooked fangs with cold light protrude from its mouth. A pair of green vertical pupils glow with a cruel cold light under the reflection of the firelight. Their wings are uniquely constructed, and the flapping of their wings makes almost no noise in the air. With the thick fog around them, they can hide their entire body. They are good at living in groups and hiding in tree holes, and they specialize in hunting in the dark at night through the mist.
This is the Mist Shadow Forest Bat, a mid-level mortal third-level spiritual beast.
The bats all over the sky gave up hiding and swooped down in the biting wind, densely packed and heading straight to the bonfire to attack the two men.
Sui Feng's light blue eyes on the branch suddenly condensed, his wings tightened, and he immediately entered a fighting state.
Just when Luo Zhi smelled the fishy smell coming towards his face, his expression suddenly changed, and his palm quickly reached towards the blue-grained meteorite gun placed vertically by his side.
Li Ziyun, who was sitting on the ground beside him, instantly lost his leisurely demeanor and quickly picked up the Spirit-horned Frost Bow lying flat on his side with his left hand. He took advantage of the situation and took half a step back, fully alert to the swarm of bats attacking from mid-air.
The formations of the bats were scattered, and the giant head bat at the front was the first to activate the move. Its wings suddenly swung wildly, and the surrounding wind elements were quickly pulled. Several solid and sharp blue wind blades flew through the air, slashing towards the two of them. The sharp energy seemed to split the flesh, muscles, and bones.
This is Broken Wind Zhanyi.
Sui Feng, who was squatting on a thick branch, suddenly stretched his wings and flew into the air with the help of Feng Shui. He faced the flying head bat hanging in the air.
Its eyes were stern, and all the violent wind spiritual power around it poured into its wings, and it flapped its wings to expel the spiritual power. Several wind blades burst out in a fan shape, intertwining with each other to form a dense wind net, and faced the wind blades hitting the sky from the head bat in a wide range.
This is Sui Feng's Blue Wind Splitting Sky Blade.
There was a loud roar, and the wind blades of both sides collided violently in mid-air. The scattered strong wind caused the surrounding dense fog to surge and shatter. The head bat hurriedly folded its wings and retreated a few feet, its body trembling slightly from the aftermath of the collision.
A large group of bats on the front line took advantage of the thick fog to cover their bodies, and the wind was surrounding them. Their bodies suddenly turned into gray-brown afterimages and sprinted at high speed. Their sharp claws and fangs were exposed, and they rushed towards the two people next to the fire from all directions.
This is the sudden passing of the wind.
Seeing several bats swooping in quickly, Li Ziyun held up the Spirit-horned Frost Bow in his left hand. The bow shook in the air, and biting cold air surged out from between the bow lines.
The right hand wearing the ice-soft leather glove suddenly pulled back the open string, causing the surrounding cold air to gather crazily.
Above the center of the bow, the cold air suddenly condensed and exploded. Three ice soul arrows, made entirely of ice crystals and filled with stunning cold light, solidified and formed out of thin air on the bowstring. The cold light at the arrow tips soared several feet, causing the air to twist layer by layer.
She opened her bow like a full moon, and spiritual power burst out from her wrists.
"Ice Soul Arrow!"
Before the word was pronounced, three ice-blue arrows shot out in unison, like three cold rays of light piercing the sky, moving as fast as a meteor. The air where they passed condensed into fine ice chips, dragging out three crystal-clear and cold light traces.
The arrows arrived in an instant, one shot directly into the head of one bat, one shot into the chest of another, and the other was nailed to the third wing. In an instant, the cold air exploded, and ice spread crazily along the three wounds. Most of the three bats' bodies were frozen stiff and unable to move. They completely lost their ability to dodge and resist, and fell heavily to the ground.
title_en: Chapter 64: The trapped bat chases west, but the ice prison stops the pursuers. Chapter 63: The spiritual fruit cleanses the body of dirt, and the ancient tree goes deep again.
